title: Easter Wishes from Letizia Perillo, WFO President
html:
Dear Friend and Colleague,

Easter is a time of renewal, hope, and the quiet courage to believe that something better is possible. In many ways, this is the very essence of our work.

Every day we, as orthodontists, witness transformation. Patients who once hid their smiles or were held back in life begin, step by step, to grow in confidence. What we do goes far beyond aligning teeth: we help restore self-esteem, self-confidence, and the simple yet powerful freedom to smile.

Across the world, there are children who hesitate to speak or be seen, adults who struggle to eat without discomfort, and entire communities where access to orthodontic care remains limited.

The message of Easter reminds us that meaningful change often begins with small, hopeful steps: one barrier removed, one life improved, one act of care that reaches further than we may ever know.

Our profession places us within this greater story. Every photograph of a patient with a full smile represents a quiet triumph over discomfort, insecurity, and missed opportunities.

And when we share our knowledge, support outreach, and advocate for access to orthodontic care, we extend that message of hope far beyond our own practices.

This Easter, I hope we can take a moment to reflect on the true value of what we do. Each appointment with a patient is not just a moment to provide orthodontic treatment, but an investment in their confidence, health, and a brighter future.

Thank you for your dedication, your expertise, and your unwavering belief in the power of transformation.

May this Easter renew your spirit, bring peace to your homes, and remind you of the countless lives you touch.

With my warmest wishes to you and your loved ones,

Sincerely,

Letizia Perillo
President
World Federation of Orthodontists
